issues.description: Numeric threshold mismatch for Aufgabe 06: the problem statement (problem_statement.md line 133) requires selecting Gemeinden with more than 100.000 male and more than 100.000 female inhabitants, but the solution (solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql line 3) uses 10.000 (WHERE einwohner_m > 10000 AND einwohner_w > 10000). This difference (one missing zero) changes the intended result set and will confuse students and cause tests to disagree with the textual requirement.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the numeric threshold inconsistency. Either update the solution query to use 100000 (e.g. WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000) so it matches the problem statement, or change the problem statement and any tests/examples to state 10.000 if that was the intended threshold. Ensure the tests and example outputs are updated to match the chosen value.
